source.title: Tentative Progression design: Hearth Fae transformation, Hearthkeeper and Beastfriend Paths
source.body:
## Owner direction — 2026-11-27
Tentative design targets, **not implementation authorization or a Christmas alpha commitment**. Make the Horse Girl/comfycore lifestyle a mechanically rewarding alternative to combat and mining, without restricting players to a benevolent aesthetic. Distinct transformation and two independently selectable Paths; compatibility matrix and enrollment rules remain to be decided. Related: #415 (other new forms), #742 (companion quest chapters), #768 (Unicorn Academy bond events), #475 (XP), #431 (canonical work ledger). Preserve the existing Newbie companion access decision; no global MXP for Newbies.

### HF-01 — Hearth Fae transformation (proposal)
Fae of hospitality, companionship and the relationship between civilization and nature, rather than a Dryad's wilderness or Forest Dragon's physiology.
- Candidate cosmetic wings/ears, passive animal attraction, improved taming/breeding, affinity with friendly Fae, benefits from cooked food/sweets/tea/recreational drinks, regeneration near home/domesticated animals, slow falling rather than free creative flight, and possible cold-iron vulnerability.
- Preserve the reason to use horses and mounts. Acquisition, diet, vulnerabilities, cosmetics, and Path compatibility need owner decisions; no assumed values.

### HK-01 — Hearthkeeper Path (tentative target; owner-specific requirement)
- Cottage, cooking, gardening, brewing, hospitality, comfort magic and domestic enchantment; candidate experience sources from productive domestic activities.
- **Food prepared by a skilled Hearthkeeper restores more hunger and carries extended potion-effect duration. Enhancements attach to the produced item stack, NOT to the consumer or a buff triggered by the Hearthkeeper eating it.** Another player can receive, trade for, store and consume the enhanced food with its benefits intact.
- Consider food and potion-bearing consumable production across supported providers; distinguish native recipe effects from externally applied effects. Research persistent item data/components, producer attribution, stack merging, recipe reprocessing, automated production and transfers without repeated enhancement or duplication. Test non-Hearthkeeper consumption and ordinary unenhanced food; decide precise eligible processes, bonuses and caps with owner.

### BF-01 — Beastfriend Path (tentative target; owner-specific requirement)
- Taming, breeding, riding, healing, discovery and adventuring alongside companions; candidate skills for mounted speed/jump, healing, recall, protection/sanctuary, breeding, expanded eligible taming and defending companions.
- **Extremely strong buffs to ALL owned pets, including undead and other non-cute companions.** No species or morality exclusion merely because the Path is cozy-themed. Secret necromancer class: a Beastfriend with an army of undead should be an intended viable fantasy, not a loophole.
- Research ownership attribution, native tameables, summoned/controlled undead and magical companions via provider-specific adapters where necessary; do not silently override native summoning caps or treat arbitrary friendly mobs as pets. Determine scope of temporary summons and existing provider ownership, buff types/magnitude, stacking, lifecycle, offline owners, and multiplayer attribution. Verify both an ordinary pet/mount and a player-owned undead companion receive substantial benefits under the same generic ownership rules.
- Reuse #768 bond milestone research, existing generic charm/taming, and companion chapter coverage rather than duplicating hooks. Candidate XP safeguards must avoid repeat-tame/breed/recall farming while allowing genuinely noncombat progression.

## Work management
All three slices: `status: needs-decision`. Decision owner: pack owner. Exact open questions above; next action: owner design review and technical decomposition, not a coding claim. Design acceptance: settle form acquisition/compatibility, eligible producer/companion ownership scope, XP and tree mechanics, and balance; then promote bounded approved slices independently. No PR, no implementation or QA evidence, no build requested. No sprint deadline assigned.
Executable behavior belongs solely to compat/progression; future Paths are config-only, with reusable engine capabilities meeting the Level 3/Nonsense Test standard and optional native adapters. Future source and gameplay acceptance must follow normal Progression integration and QA gates. No new dependencies or native restrictions approved by this issue.

comments.text:
## HF-01 owner design refinement — 2026-11-27
- Sage skill: greatly extend duration and effective radius of burning Sage; verify actual Hexerei provider/ownership and configurable duration/range hooks before specifying numbers. No global buff to unrelated players' Sage by default (implementation proposal, not locked).
- **Hurry Home**: teleport to the player's bed. Safe destination validation, missing/obstructed bed handling, dimensions, activation/cooldown and combat behavior remain design questions. Do not restore arbitrary `/home` access.
- **Diet: only processed foods made from combined ingredient sources.** Supersedes the previous broad cooked-food affinity proposal: raw foods and merely cooking a single source do not qualify. Reuse shared recipe-provenance/tag-based physiology engine (#444); distinct source families vs ingredients, bread/dough, drinks, magical foods and other edge cases require owner decisions. No assumed exceptions.
- Substantial Feywild integrations, explicitly including better flight. Audit actual pinned Feywild capabilities/wing tiers and native gate coexistence (#330); earlier slow-fall-only candidate does not limit eventual enhanced Feywild flight. Exact upgrade mechanics and native interactions TBD; no free baseline creative flight approved.
All are tentative design targets, not coding or build authorization. HF-01 remains needs-decision; #431 already tracks the parent. Suggested acceptance once specified: compare Sage duration/radius to native baseline; own-bed teleport valid/invalid cases; reject raw/single-source cooked and accept verified multi-source dishes; demonstrate Feywild flight improvements with no native progression bypass unless explicitly approved.

## HF-01 — Hurry Home owner decision (2026-11-27)
Hurry Home must match the actual configured FTB /home functionality, except its destination is always the player's bed rather than an arbitrary /sethome location. Cross-dimensional travel is available from the initial unlock; no separate dimensional upgrade or rank gate. Follow existing FTB Home behavior/restrictions for activation, cooldown, warmup, safety and other relevant mechanics as applicable; verify actual installed provider/config before implementing, and define bed-missing/invalid handling consistently. Do not grant ordinary /sethome or arbitrary home destinations. This supersedes the prior open dimensional question. Remaining Hearth Fae design remains tentative; no coding/build authorization or status promotion.

comments.text:
## HF-01 — Atlas-backed first design pass and owner flower physiology decision (2026-11-27)
**Owner requirement:** Proximity to actual planted flowers provides regeneration and small amounts of saturation. Potted flowers do NOT qualify. Use reusable server-side environmental predicates (configurable flower tags, bounded nearby checks, explicit non-potted eligibility); exact radius, frequency, regeneration strength and saturation increment/cap remain balance decisions. Avoid replacing the combined-source diet with full passive feeding. Test actual planted vs potted, no flowers, removal/movement, and modded flowers.

**Verified native findings:** [Feywild 5.6.4 Atlas](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/blob/test/full-integration/docs/mod-capabilities/mods/feywild.md), PR #701, SHA1 e59b68dd85b92ebbdbde478ea4e52fdb8b84c9d0; [Hexerei 0.5.0.3 Atlas](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/blob/test/full-integration/docs/mod-capabilities/mods/hexerei.md), PR #683, SHA512 6ad9f14ad23e84e693c8a02fa210871f7f9f7abb34acb342d9c72aacaa822dc4d06d203d78803ab40dd5eb334344961586a3f223ae877c362f1788b7be1dad6a. Both match checked Packwiz pins. Prior exact-JAR research, not gameplay acceptance.

### Candidate racial branches (suggestions, not approved numbers or implementation)
- Seasonal Pixies: Spring breeds nearby eligible animals without feeding (8-block AABB); Summer grows eligible CropBlocks (±8 cube); Autumn resets mature crops and drops clone item, not full harvest loot (±8); Winter produces animal loot then damages adult eligible animals (8-block AABB, excludes certain tamed entities, may kill). Consider Spring frequency/range, Summer frequency/area, Autumn frequency/yield, Winter yield, preserving native eligibility/ownership and avoiding accidental loot multiplication. All require active ability, same-level owner and ticking entities; no offline automation assumption.
- Lesser Fey: Mandragora flower growth frequency/range; Shroomling controlled mushroom-cow conversion; Bee Knight defensive abilities; Bellsnickel barter/book-copy costs (respect existing enchantment economy); Ent blessing range/strength and mounted mobility. Keep generic pet combat buffs in Beastfriend.
- Racial flight candidates: Featherlight slow fall, Pixie Wings native-style glide/visible wings, Greater Wings speed/control, True Fae innate creative flight after legitimate native functional tiara acquisition, Swift Wings creative-flight speed. Native base Wing Tiara is non-flight, guaranteed normal loot from each of four 300HP sovereigns (Oberon, Titania, Ashen Lord, Mab); all six functional variants use base tiara + Elytra + Nether Star + Fey Dust + matching seasonal scroll or Blaze Rod/Echo Shard, no ongoing fuel/durability. Do not assume tiered native flight; preserve #330 provider ownership/coexistence and native progression unless owner revises.
- Hearth magic: Sage Plate native configured range48, ~63 minutes loaded/lit, only natural monster spawning; candidate radius96 and 4x duration (~4h12m), per-skilled-owner/item applicability rather than global config. Potion candles reach AABB inflated5 and up20, refresh every160t with 200t base effect; candidate range/duration upgrades. Growth candles attempt three crop bonemeals periodically; candidate frequency/coverage. Ordinary candle burn extension; weather candle remains native global level effect, not a proposed buff. Hurry Home follows already recorded owner decision: bed-only equivalent of FTB /home, cross-dimensional from initial unlock.
- Transformation ritual candidate: custom five-input Fey Altar scroll, Fey Gem + Blank Summoning Scroll + Cake + Dried Sage Bundle + Spring Pixie Summoning Scroll; altar supports five-input unordered recipes, but player transformation is custom, not native. Early noncombat acquisition proposal.
- Other physiology candidates: combined-source food-only (owner requirement already recorded), cosmetic wings/ears, iron weapon vulnerability (native Fey iron-sensitive blocking is precedent, not a native player vulnerability), friendly nonboss Fey affinity, regeneration near bed (prior proposal; flower-based regeneration/saturation now explicit).
- Candidate racial MXP: summon Fey, native quest completion, discover/grow seasonal flora, trade, craft/light Sage/candles, discover eligible dishes, one-time four sovereign victories; validate event attribution and dedup/anti-farming. Independent of Hearthkeeper production and Beastfriend general companion bonuses.

**Status:** HF-01 remains needs-decision; owner decides acquisition, flight gates, skill balance and progression sources; engineering writer to decompose reusable capabilities after decisions. #431 canonical ledger already links #822. No code, recipe, config, PR, build or gameplay changes.

comments.text:
## HF-01 — owner flower balance and four-stage flight refinement (2026-11-27)
**Flower proximity:** while within three blocks of an actually planted flower (not potted), restore 1 hunger point and 1 saturation point every minute. Small bonus; ordinary food/saturation caps, no multiplication by number of flowers proposed, no banked offline ticks. Previously requested regeneration remains, strength/cadence TBD. One hunger point = half a shank, not one full icon; 60 seconds = 1200 ticks nominal. Exact distance metric and modded flower eligibility to verify. Supersedes earlier unspecified nutrition radius/rate.
**Flight design direction:** (I) overworld-achievable early slow manual flight via midair jumps, mild slow fall and fall damage protection; (II) on finding/acquiring an Elytra, unlock toggleable innate Elytra flight; (III) on personally defeating a Fey sovereign, unlock normal-speed full creative flight, no wing-tiara crafting gate; (IV) on crafting any functional upgraded Feywild Wing Tiara, unlock fast creative flight. Supersedes prior proposal requiring a functional tiara for ordinary creative flight. Suggested toggle of speed boost for building, not owner-locked. Reuse shared Progression flight/jump/attribute providers, #330 ownership coexistence, verified boss and recipe acquisition events; avoid native wing flag clobber and keep server-authoritative ownership/reset. Exact stage I acquisition, jump tuning and fall protection semantics, stage II legitimate acquisition event, stage III verified kill credit, stage IV native crafting attribution, speed multiplier/toggle and earlier skill interaction remain to settle. No equipment sacrifice beyond actual native tier-IV recipe assumed. Tentative design record, no coding or build authorization; HF-01 remains needs-decision and tracked by #431.

comments.text:
## HF-01 — complete Hearth Fae tree proposal v1 (owner requested; 2026-11-27)
Design only. Monk reference #721, live dev/progression monk.json blob 86f8282895c3fa9f705bcdf2f5344899ddad369f, Classic #722 README; newer Sea Dragon #831 shows 100 one-point ranks, free qualitative deeds, native baseline. Apply one point/rank, additive meaningful increments, one purchase per numerical stat/context, no filler, no duplicate Core stats; no mandatory purchase ordering proposed. The 100-point budget is a candidate, not a universal mandate or approved balance. No Classic/Unlimited split for this equipment-using form. Existing #822 owner decisions control.

### Enrollment and innate physiology
Candidate Blessing of the Hearth: custom 5-input Fey Altar scroll (Fey Gem, Blank Summoning Scroll, Cake, Dried Sage Bundle, Spring Pixie Summoning Scroll), use personally after graduation with legal native/Path compatibility; ritual/cure and visual hooks require approval. Owner: only combined-source processed food; actual planted flowers within 3 blocks restore 1 hunger and 1 saturation per 60 seconds, no stacking by flowers proposed, ordinary caps; regeneration near planted flowers is innate, magnitude unresolved (candidate +0.1 HP/s while near flowers). Candidate innate cosmetic wings/ears, non-boss Fey friendliness, iron vulnerability (exact interaction and severity TBD). No paid physiology, blanket pet combat or crafted-food enhancements; Beastfriend and Hearthkeeper retain those niches.

### Free challenge entitlements (0 points, 0 automatic challenge XP; separate ordinary MXP awards)
1. Fledgling Wings: personally summon an eligible seasonal Pixie after enrollment (candidate Overworld deed). Grant slow repeatable midair jump/manual flight, mild slow fall and fall damage protection as one flight capability; no creative hover. Tuning candidate repeated upward impulses capped below normal creative speed, no stacking with other providers.
2. Greater Wings: legitimately acquire an Elytra after qualifying for I; toggleable innate Elytra glide. Verify legitimate acquisition and policy for prior possessions, no arbitrary advancement bypass.
3. True Fae: personally defeat any Fey sovereign (Oberon, Titania, Ashen Lord, Mab). Full normal-speed creative flight; no functional tiara or Elytra required for this boss gate itself; stage II is the proposed previous progression stage, preserve any native provider independent entitlement. Settle whether out-of-order legitimate receipts activate immediately or wait for previous stage; propose record after enrollment and activate in stage order. 
4. Sovereign Wings: personally craft any of six native functional wing tiaras; fast creative flight, proposed 2× native flying speed toggle, default normal speed in precision builds. Do not count acquisition of someone else's crafted item. Verify recipe output event, full native costs, ownership reset, #330 provider coexistence.
5. Hurry Home: candidate separate challenge personally sleep in own bed after enrollment; FTB /home equivalent with current bed-only destination and cross-dimension from initial unlock, exact configured warmup/cooldown/safety. No arbitrary home command entitlement.
Use readable challenge HUD; one qualitative reward per deed (compound mechanics of Fledgling Wings are deliberately a single flight package). No purchase ranks for flight stages; optional keybinds use existing generic activation/Controls. No synthetic MXP/points awarded by deeds.

### Purchased tree — 20 skills, 100 ranks (all one point)
#### Seasonal Court (40 points)
| ID | Skill | Ranks | Candidate additive increment/endpoint |
|---|---|---:|---|
| spring_rhythm | Spring Rhythm | 5 | +20% of native eligible goal-start rate/rank (2× at max); preserve breeding cooldown |
| spring_reach | Spring Reach | 5 | +1 block native search radius/rank (8→13) |
| summer_rhythm | Summer Rhythm | 5 | +20% of native eligible goal-start rate/rank (2×) |
| summer_reach | Summer Reach | 5 | +1 block cube half-width/rank (8→13); bounded scan work |
| autumn_reach | Autumn Reach | 5 | +1 block cube half-width/rank (8→13); bounded scan work |
| autumn_bounty | Autumn Bounty | 5 | +20 percentage points chance of one extra native clone-output stack per successful harvest/rank (100% max; not full loot) |
| winter_reach | Winter Reach | 5 | +1 block search radius/rank (8→13) |
| winter_bounty | Winter Bounty | 5 | +20 percentage points chance of one extra eligible native generated loot result/rank (100% max); preserve actual animal damage and exclusions; no duplicated boss/protected drops |

#### Hearthcraft (30 points)
| ID | Skill | Ranks | Candidate additive increment/endpoint |
|---|---|---:|---|
| sage_reach | Sacred Ground | 5 | +9.6 blocks effective radius/rank (48→96 nominal; integer rounding and exact native distance predicate verified later) |
| sage_endurance | Everlasting Sage | 5 | +60% of native duration/rank (4× at max; ~252 loaded minutes) |
| candle_burn | Everlasting Flame | 5 | +40% native burn duration/rank (3× max) |
| candle_reach | Candle Circle | 5 | +1 block horizontal AABB reach/rank (5→10); leave native vertical reach unchanged |
| candle_duration | Lingering Light | 5 | +40 ticks to finite native candle effect duration/rank (200→400 ticks); instant effects excluded |
| growth_rhythm | Garden Lights | 5 | -10 percentage points of native growth-candle pulse interval/rank (160→80 ticks at default; minimum interval guard) |

#### Lesser Fey & Ents (30 points)
| ID | Skill | Ranks | Candidate additive increment/endpoint |
|---|---|---:|---|
| mandragora_rhythm | Flowersong | 5 | +20% of native eligible flower-placement goal rate/rank (2×) |
| mandragora_reach | Flower Garden | 5 | +1 block eligible placement search radius/rank; actual baseline and safe placement audit needed |
| fey_barter | Fairy Bargain | 5 | +10 percentage points chance of one additional eligible non-book barter output/rank (50%); exclude protected loot and book copying |
| ent_blessing_reach | Sheltering Boughs | 5 | +0.75 blocks seasonal blessing repulsion radius/rank (+3.75) |
| ent_blessing_force | Stalwart Grove | 5 | +0.15 native repulsion strength/rank (1.5→2.25), preserve native target filter |
| ent_mount_speed | Wind in the Leaves | 5 | +10% of native Ent mounted speed/rank (1.5× at max); additive with applicable native/Beastfriend mount bonuses subject to safe cap |
Ranks are proposed tuning, not runtime-supported claims. Native 5.6.4 Feywild and 0.5.0.3 Hexerei reference #701/#683 and prior #822 Atlas comment; effective configured pack values and legal gear stacking require verification. Use baseline-relative additive increases, not compounding; rate is not promised actual throughput; use bounded owner-attributed queries and no force-loading. For Sage/Candles propose capture qualified player's bonuses at lighting/placement or producer interaction as appropriate, not server-global config; clarify lifecycle and shared ownership. Do not extend weather candle scope or amplify instant potions. Preserve native Autumn clone output and Winter damage/eligibility; all output buffs need economy/replication audit. No duplicate book copying discount or broad pet damage/HP stats; Shroomling variant controls and Bee Knight defensive changes remain optional qualitative design candidates, no filler purchases.

### MXP proposal (not final rates)
Use existing configurable XP channel/routing, no parallel currency by default. Personal completed native Fey quests and first unique Fey summons/seasonal flora/dish discoveries as one-time ordinary source receipts (candidate 100 base MXP each); meaningful repeatable successful Fey altar crafting, personal garden harvest, legitimate gem barter, placing/lighting new valid Sage or potion/growth candles (candidate 5–20 base MXP per verified productive action, calibrate). Sovereign victory through existing verified boss/advancement policy, no double payout for challenge receipt. No reclick, relight, place/break, dismiss/resummon, self-trade or offline tick XP loops; don't count unattended ambient Pixie actions as direct player XP by default. Noncombat progression must remain viable; calibrate actual earn rates and growth. Prefer native tags and source-provenance categories, no hardcoded path logic.

### Engine handoff and decision holds
Existing engine patterns: native attribute/mode/achievement/strict challenge/XP machinery, verified acquisition and recipe events to audit rather than assume. Missing or unverified reusable capabilities: custom transformation/eligibility and cosmetic persistence; processed-food permission using #444; bounded planted-flower environmental nutrition/regen; aerial jump/fall/flight lifecycle; bed-only teleport using FTB configured rules; Feywild owner-scoped goal/loot/blessing/mount adapters; Hexerei owner-attributed burn/range/duration adapters; native Fey quest/recipe/boss event evidence. All runtime code belongs to compat/progression, form data config-only. Each adapter must pass Nonsense Test, validate actual pinned provider ABI, multiplayer ownership, respec/cure and reload, absence of optional provider, no duplicate bonuses; no new dependencies.
Owner review: proposed 100 rank allocation, acquisition/cure and Path compatibility, order of flight receipt activation, regeneration, cold iron, stage I tuning, stage IV speed/toggle, exact XP rates and native integration economy limits. HF-01 remains needs-decision; #431 canonical ledger already tracks #822; no coding claim, no live path JSON, no PR, no runtime acceptance/build. Next: owner review, then split settled bounded requirements from engine investigation.
